title: Fix Admin Authorization Error & Merge Earnings into Live List Tab

requirements.text: Fix the backend authorization logic so that Admin users (principals with admin role) are accepted for all actions currently gated to 'users only', including creating comment lists, adding templates, uploading, and any other actions that currently throw 'Unauthorized: Only users can add comment lists'. Admins must be treated as authorized for all user-level operations.

quotes: Unauthorized: Only users can add comment lists
this error is still here after entering into Admin Panel and creating list or something this error show that only user can create or upload

acceptanceCriteria: An authenticated Admin user can create a comment list without receiving an 'Unauthorized' error.
An authenticated Admin user can add templates to comment lists without error.
An authenticated Admin user can upload content without receiving an 'Unauthorized' error.
The authorization check accepts both 'user' and 'admin' roles for all previously user-only gated operations.
Non-authenticated (anonymous) principals are still correctly rejected.

requirements.text: Remove the separate 'Earnings' tab from the main navigation in App.tsx and merge its content (the EarningsChecker view) directly into the Live Checker tab/view, so users can access earnings lookup within the Live List/Live Checker section without a separate tab.

quotes: remove and merge into the live list list
shift the earnings into live list

acceptanceCriteria: The standalone 'Earnings' tab is no longer visible in the main navigation.
The EarningsChecker content (username lookup, wallet entry, payout request) is accessible from within the Live Checker tab.
No earnings functionality is lost — all EarningsChecker features remain fully functional after the merge.
The Live Checker tab layout is coherent with the merged earnings section (e.g., as a sub-section or secondary tab within Live Checker).

constraints: Do not remove or break any existing earnings or payout request functionality.
The fix must not loosen security for anonymous/unauthenticated principals — only admin principals should gain elevated access.
nonGoals: Redesigning the admin panel UI beyond the tab merge.
Adding new earnings features or changing earnings calculation logic.
